set.typical_award_size: HACSC had 823 PBVs in 33 developments as of February 2025, including in Hollister: Sunrise Senior Apartments (48, CHISPA), West of Fairview (40, in development) and Baler Place (25, in development). PBVs are awarded through a competitive RFP (last issued as the Fall 2024 PBV RFP, open October 15 to November 18, 2024); the planned Spring-Summer 2025 RFP was cancelled because of federal funding uncertainty and no RFP has been reissued as of November 2026. Fall 2024 scoring: 200 base points (project type 45, waiting list opportunities 25, poverty deconcentration 10, additional non-PBV affordable units 50, location amenities 14, management and owner experience 6, construction readiness 15, community engagement 5, financial feasibility 30) plus up to 10 bonus points; threshold 125 points for new construction and 120 for existing housing. The Fall 2024 RFP also offered up to 15 VASH vouchers.
set.per_unit_cap: Fall 2024 RFP project cap: the greater of 15 PBVs or 40% of units in the project. HACSC August 2026 owner guidance says HUD allows up to 50% of authorized vouchers program-wide and up to 100% of units per project, with HACSC free to set lower limits for new awards.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: HACSC Project-Based Voucher Program Guidance for Owners/Developers (effective August 1, 2026), Prevailing Wage and Labor Standards: new construction or rehabilitation projects with a conditional award of nine or more PBVs are subject to the Davis-Bacon Act, Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act and 29 CFR part 5 (consistent with 24 CFR 983 PBV labor standards). https://hacosantacruz.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/PBV-Guidance-August-2026-FINAL.pdf
set.audit_note: Nov 9, 2026 spot check: prior scoring breakdown (project type 50, 150-point threshold, supportive services supplement) did not match the Fall 2024 RFP scoring document; replaced. RFP pause confirmed on the HACSC RFP page. New August 2026 owner guidance (expires June 30, 2027) replaces the 2022 guidance.
